description: This file defines a database migration class for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, specifically migrating from version 16 to 17 by adding a new column to the NOTES table to store scroll position.

classes.name: Migration_16_17
classes.description: A migration class extending Room's Migration to handle database schema changes from version 16 to 17.

methods.name: Migration_16_17
methods.description: Constructor initializing migration from version 16 to 17.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes SQL command to add a new column 'SCROLL_Y' to the NOTES table.
